an5.84:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.84:1.3: Assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottāpi hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti.
an5.84:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo cā ti. 3.
an5.84:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.84:2.3: Saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottāpi hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
an5.84:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā
